findings.text: The task assumes an alias under `COLLATE` is never associated, but SQLite associates it with the last matching result expression: with rows `('a',1),('A',3)` in `t(c,n)`, `SELECT c||'' AS k,(c||'') COLLATE NOCASE,max(n) FROM t GROUP BY k COLLATE NOCASE` returns `('A','a',3)`, because the second result column matches ([SQLite resolver](https://www3.sqlite.org/matrix/ev/src/resolve.html)). Fix: qualify this rule and the D4 note so the expanded alias, including its `COLLATE` clauses, follows D5’s last-matching-result association rule.
